meta.name: Trial by Fire
meta.description: After the deadly Uphaar cinema fire, two grief-stricken parents navigate the loss of their kids and a dogged fight for justice.

videos.title: Trial by Fire
videos.overview: The loss of their two children in a devastating fire spurs Neelam and Shekhar Krishnamoorthy to learn more about the deadly incident.

videos.title: A.V.U.T.
videos.overview: Neelam and Shekhar scour for information — and support — in their fight against the Ansals. One man grapples with the tragic toll on his family.

videos.title: Memorial
videos.overview: Police make arrests in the fire case but the association for victims' families faces greater hurdles ahead. The Krishnamoorthys receive an offer.

videos.title: Uphaar
videos.overview: The case finally reaches court but a floundering prosecutor causes concerns. On the day of the fire, a theater employee struggles to clear a debt.

videos.title: Heroes
videos.overview: Neelam reaches a crossroad. Shekhar meets an old friend who is unaware of the fire. As "Border" premieres, an army captain grapples with regret.

videos.title: Villains
videos.overview: Tangled in the crosshairs of powerful men and the law, the city worker who last checked the faulty transformer before the fire is made a scapegoat.

videos.title: Border
videos.overview: After the Supreme Court verdict is rendered, a flashback to the fateful day in 1997 and the events that unspooled as 59 people perished in the fire.
